scope: Actual hook and Home action source transpiled into a minimal hook/state harness; simulated React scheduling, localStorage and provider callbacks. No DOM/browser claims.

results.name: Home sends once, appends user immediately and navigates through transition
Clear during pending cannot orphan the active response
Response appends to the same session after route child changes
Existing storage key restores conversation in a fresh hook instance (simulated localStorage)
Error unlocks send; repeated retry issues one request without duplicating user
Unconfigured, empty and oversized sends are rejected
Open Chat without message does not call Gemini
Storage failure is visible without discarding live conversation
Materials, summaries, quizzes, challenges and performance code unchanged
